prompts.writing.outline.detailed: Outline a text on “[topic]” for [audience], length [length]. Goal: [goal]. Give 4–6 sections: a heading and 1–2 points I'll develop myself. Mark where I'll need an example or a sourced fact.
prompts.writing.outline.refine: Reorder the sections so the most important point comes first, and explain why.
prompts.writing.outline.check: Here's my outline: [outline]. Are there logical gaps or repetitions?
prompts.writing.clarity.short: Make this text clearer without changing the meaning: [text]
prompts.writing.clarity.detailed: Improve the clarity of this text for [audience]. Rules: short sentences, one idea per sentence, no bureaucratic phrasing, keep the meaning and facts, keep my style. Show the 5 main edits as “before → after” with a reason. Text: [text]
prompts.writing.clarity.refine: Edit [number] changes the meaning. Suggest another version that keeps my point.
prompts.writing.clarity.check: List 3 places in my text a reader might misunderstand and explain why.
prompts.writing.shorten.short: Cut this text by about half: [text]
prompts.writing.shorten.detailed: Shorten the text to [length]. Keep all facts, dates, conditions and my tone. Remove repetition, filler words and vague phrases. After the text, list exactly what you removed so I can restore anything important. Text: [text]
prompts.writing.shorten.refine: Put back the part about [part], it matters, and cut something else instead.
prompts.writing.shorten.check: Compare the original and shortened texts: was anything lost that changes the meaning?
prompts.writing.repeats.short: Find repeated words and ideas in this text: [text]
prompts.writing.repeats.detailed: Find repeated words, close repeats of the same root and ideas said twice in the text. For each, suggest a replacement or a way to merge. Don't rewrite the whole text; give a list of edits. Text: [text]
prompts.writing.repeats.refine: Suggest 5 synonyms for “[word]” that fit the style.
prompts.writing.repeats.check: I've fixed the repetition. New version: [text]. Are any noticeable repeats left?
prompts.writing.structure.short: Check the structure of this text: [text]
prompts.writing.structure.detailed: Check the text's structure: is there a clear introduction, logical transitions between paragraphs and a conclusion that answers the main question? Summarise each paragraph's main point in one sentence. Mark paragraphs to reorder or merge. Text: [text]
prompts.writing.structure.check: Here are my paragraphs' main points: [list]. Do they add up to a coherent story?
prompts.writing.tone.short: Rewrite this text in a [tone] tone: [text]
prompts.writing.tone.detailed: Change the text's tone to [tone] for [recipient]. Keep the meaning, facts and roughly the same length. Don't add promises or apologies that aren't in the original. Give 2 versions: softer and firmer. Text: [text]
prompts.writing.tone.refine: The second version is too harsh. Make it polite but firm.
prompts.writing.tone.check: How might [recipient] read my text? Point out phrases that could come across differently than I intend.
prompts.writing.audience.detailed: Adapt the text for [audience]. They know: [what they know]; they don't know: [what they don't know]. Replace difficult words, add explanations where needed and keep all facts. Length: no more than [length]. Text: [text]
prompts.writing.audience.refine: Make another version for [another audience] and show the main differences.
prompts.writing.audience.check: Ask 3 questions a reader from [audience] might ask after this text.
prompts.writing.headlines.short: Suggest 10 headlines for a text about [topic].
prompts.writing.headlines.detailed: Suggest 10 headlines for the text. Audience: [audience]. Main point: [point]. Mix types: question, benefit, number, quote. No clickbait or promises the text doesn't keep, up to [number] words each.
prompts.writing.headlines.refine: I like option [number]. Make 5 variations of it.
prompts.writing.headlines.check: Which of these headlines best reflects the text and why? [headlines]
prompts.writing.notes.short: Turn my notes into a connected draft: [notes]
prompts.writing.notes.detailed: Turn my notes into a connected draft for [goal]. Use only what's in the notes and add nothing. Where a link or fact is missing, mark it [to write]. Keep my wording where possible. Notes: [notes]
prompts.writing.notes.refine: Develop the part marked [to write] in two versions and I'll choose.
prompts.writing.notes.check: Compare the draft with the notes: is there anything in the draft that wasn't in the notes?
prompts.writing.edits.short: Find the mistakes in this text and explain each: [text]
prompts.writing.edits.detailed: Edit the text like a careful editor. Give a table: “fragment — problem — fix — why”. Check spelling, punctuation, agreement and clarity. Don't change my style or rewrite the whole text. Text: [text]
prompts.writing.edits.refine: Explain the rule behind edit [number] in more detail and give 2 examples.
prompts.writing.edits.check: Give me 5 sentences with the same kinds of mistakes I made. I'll fix them and you check.

verify.writing.outline: The outline is yours: make sure it has everything you wanted to say and remove points that aren't yours.
verify.writing.clarity: Read the result aloud and compare with the original: the meaning and facts must stay the same.
verify.writing.shorten: Check that no important facts, conditions or numbers disappeared when shortening.
verify.writing.repeats: Sometimes repetition is there for emphasis: accept only the edits you agree with.
verify.writing.structure: Structure is your decision. Treat the notes as suggestions, not mandatory edits.
verify.writing.tone: Check whether the tone suits the reader: reread the text from their point of view.
verify.writing.audience: Check the adapted text for accuracy: simplifying must not turn into distorting.
verify.writing.headlines: A headline must not promise more than the text delivers. Check each option against the content.
verify.writing.notes: The draft is a starting point for your own work. Check the AI didn't add facts that weren't in your notes.
verify.writing.edits: Accept edits one by one and check the rules in a style guide if in doubt.
